traffic_conditions.reconciliation_note: In this lost-time study, no emergency ambulance was dispatched (civilian traffic only). In scenario_benchmark.csv, an ambulance was dispatched at tick 15 with active preemption, imposing minor cross-traffic delay (+0.05s in moderate load, +1.38s in rush hour). Thus at lost_time=0s: Hybrid (BF) wait is 18.06s without ambulance vs 18.11s with ambulance (moderate load), and 80.53s without ambulance vs 81.91s with ambulance (rush hour).
